## Summary

This PR includes several major enhancements to the BSG Demo Platform:

### JWT Token Monitoring
- **Backend**: Added `/deployment/temenos/jwt-info` endpoint to decode and return JWT token status
- **Frontend**: Display JWT expiration information in Demo Settings with visual indicators (green/red)
- Shows user email, expiration date, days remaining, and token status
- Light purple background styling for easy identification

### Editable RAG Prompts
- Added ability to view and edit RAG API prompts before querying
- Implemented for all three tooltip refresh buttons (Kafka, Public Catalog, Open Standards)
- Blue-highlighted prompt sections in approval modals with textarea inputs
- Allows users to customize queries without code changes

### RAG Error Handling & Caching
- Improved error handling with detailed error messages from backend
- 30-day caching system for RAG content with refresh capability
- Fallback to cached content when refresh fails
- Better timeout handling (70s) for RAG API queries

### Component Improvements
- **Security Component**: Recreated frontend with tabbed interface
- **Deployment Analyzer**: Enhanced AKS namespace discovery and capability extraction
- **API Overview**: Added tooltip caching and UI enhancements
- Improved adapter initialization logging

### Infrastructure
- Updated GitHub Actions workflow for app service deployment
- Added comprehensive documentation (ADAPTERS_EXPLANATION.md, FIX guides)
- Backend restart scripts and test utilities
- Azure connection troubleshooting scripts

## Technical Details

**Files Modified**: 50+ files across backend and frontend
**New Features**: 4 major features
**Bug Fixes**: Multiple RAG timeout and error handling issues
**Documentation**: 7 new markdown guides
